d: The Accountant is responsible for accurately recording daily financial transactions and managing receipts, payments, expenses, and payroll. The role includes executing bank transfers, preparing monthly and closing entries, maintaining secure and organized financial records, and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of accounting entries. The Accountant is also responsible for reconciling customer, bank, and supplier balances and resolving any discrepancies.
Accurately record all daily financial transactions.
Process and record receipts and payments on a daily basis.
Record daily expenses and prepare payroll statements.
Execute bank transfers and monitor banking operations.
Prepare monthly accounting entries and closing entries.
Maintain secure, organized, and accessible financial records.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of all accounting entries.
Conduct periodic reconciliations of customer, bank, and supplier balances to identify and resolve discrepancies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or an equivalent qualification.

d: AHS is a Dubai-based group focused on ultra-luxury real estate development, strategic investments, and high-value ventures. The business is built around exceptional standards, thoughtful execution, and high-touch experiences for a discerning global clientele.

Within this environment, every client interaction reflects the brand. This role supports a premium front-of-house experience where service, presentation, and attention to detail are central to how clients experience the Sales Gallery.

As Waiter, you will play an important part in creating a refined and welcoming atmosphere for ultra-high-net-worth clients, working closely with hospitality and sales colleagues to deliver a seamless visit from arrival through departure.
q: At least a high school education.
5+ years of experience serving private events and delivering UHNW guest service.
Guest-facing service experience with discerning international clients.
Availability for client visits, private events, evenings, and weekends.
5+ years of experience in luxury hotels.
Knowledge of premium beverage service, presentation, and luxury-service etiquette.
r: Serve premium refreshments with polished presentation and impeccable luxury-service etiquette.
Welcome UHNW clients and provide attentive service throughout Sales Gallery visits.
Anticipate client preferences while maintaining discretion, professionalism, and strict confidentiality.
Keep guest-facing spaces, service stations, and presentation materials immaculately prepared.
Coordinate with sales and hospitality teams to ensure seamless client experiences.
